tool_description: DeepBrainNet is a deep learning model that predicts brain age from skull-stripped and aligned T1-weighted MRI scans. It uses a convolutional neural network trained on over 11,000 subjects from diverse populations.
tool_author: Vishnu Bashyam et al.; reimplemented by ANTsPyNet
demo_commands: python -c "import ants; from antspynet.utilities import brain_age; img = ants.image_read('/path/to/image.nii.gz'); print(brain_age(img, do_preprocessing=False)['predicted_age'])"

image_path.description: Path to a skull-stripped, aligned T1-weighted MRI scan in NIfTI format.

do_preprocessing.description: Set to true if preprocessing (e.g., skull stripping, normalization) is needed. Otherwise, provide pre-aligned, skull-stripped images.

predicted_age.description: The predicted biological brain age (in years) as output by the model.

execution.entrypoint_template: python -c "import ants; from antspynet.utilities import brain_age; img = ants.image_read('{image_path}'); print(brain_age(img, do_preprocessing={do_preprocessing})['predicted_age'])"
